scientific_integrity.computational_scope: Standalone standard-library regression checks for six primes only; generality follows from the proof, not the samples.
scientific_integrity.mathematical_basis: Explicit projective equalizer, exact restriction of the cubic, smoothness by a gradient-product argument, Eisenstein calculation, and tangent Jordan quotient.

scientific_limitations: The fixed scheme is for the coordinate p-cycle on the displayed integral model, not for arbitrary order-p automorphisms.
No quotient or automorphism group scheme is computed; characteristic three is excluded.
Priority relative to uninspected modular-automorphism literature is not independently established.
title: Cyclotomic collision of fixed points on smooth cyclic Klein cubics
